name: Darksteel Angel
oracle_text:
Flying, indestructible
You can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game.
Creatures you control can't have -1/-1 counters put on them.
blocked_sentences: Creatures you control can't have -1/-1 counters put on them.

needs.what: a static effect that stops counters of a named kind (here -1/-1) from being put on permanents matching an affects filter (creatures you control), covering effects, costs, wither/infect damage and enters-with counters alike
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_counters only scales a placement (counter_multiplier is refused below 2 and counter_addend adds), so there is no way to reduce a placement to zero; prevent_damage and the cant_* statics do not touch counters
